title: The Halloween Mystery at Willow House
content:
On Halloween night, a group of children decided to visit an old house at the end of their street.

Many people believed that the house was haunted, but the children wanted to discover the truth.

When they arrived, they saw strange footprints near the door. The footprints were much larger than their own feet.

Inside the house, they found old pictures of men and women wearing unusual costumes.

Suddenly, they heard a noise coming from the kitchen. A group of mice ran across the floor, and everyone screamed.

Then, they noticed something even stranger: several pairs of sharp teeth were displayed inside a glass box.

Outside, a few geese flew over the house while the wind became stronger. The children quickly realized that they were not alone.

However, the mysterious sounds did not come from ghosts or monsters. An old woman and her grandchildren were preparing a surprise Halloween party inside the house.

The children laughed with relief and joined the other people at the party. It was certainly the most surprising Halloween night they had ever experienced!
